sentence: Survive your peanathon first. The egrack will find you in the dark.

wombos.definition: A marathon of peans — back-to-back peak cinema analyses run end-to-end without pause. The endurance event of the peanemis world.
wombos.example: We're doing a peanathon this tweekend — three movies, two essays, one nap.

wombos.definition: The moment a person realizes or comes to terms with their true gender identity — the cracking of the metaphorical egg.
wombos.example: Looking back, that conversation was basically her egrack.
